title.narrative: Enhancing Water Governance and Cooperation for Effective Implementation of the IHP Strategy in the Maghreb

description.narrative: The programme aims to strengthen water governance, regional cooperation, and knowledge-based decision-making in the Maghreb through the effective implementation of UNESCO’s Intergovernmental Hydrological Programme Strategy. In a context characterized by increasing water scarcity, climate change impacts, growing water demands, and the need for enhanced transboundary cooperation, the programme seeks to support Member States in developing integrated, inclusive, and sustainable approaches to water resources management. Its objectives include strengthening institutional and technical capacities, promoting water diplomacy and cooperation among countries of the region, advancing scientific research and data sharing, and fostering the integration of climate resilience and ecosystem-based approaches into water policies and planning. Key activities will include the organization of regional dialogues and technical workshops, support for national and regional IHP initiatives, capacity-building programmes for water professionals and decision-makers, promotion of knowledge exchange and best practices, development of policy recommendations and technical guidance, and facilitation of partnerships among governments, academic institutions, civil society organizations, and regional networks. Through the noted actions, the programme will contribute to strengthening water security, sustainable development, and regional cooperation across the Maghreb.
